text: Android: collaborator-change notifications suppress every edit by another account on this phone, even edits made on the web

On main (abb1c182), full gate green: the self-edit filter reads the device off the item's newest field clock (deletion included); a Diagnostics line 'Last change check: <time>, foreign items pulled: N, <outcome>' names the gate that stopped a notification. Test counts app 800 -> 809.
